CameraComponent.summary: Returns the front camera rendering at view point.

Component.note: Disables the component. The boot music (Main.bootBGM) is disabled this way by main.lua and by the Shonen firmware.

FileUtils.summary: Calls list directory files by ext.

LabelComponent.summary: Sets the text from string id.

SoundComponent.note: Returns 0.0 when the component has no native sound object; it does not raise an error.
Returns false when the component has no native sound object (for example a disabled one); it does not raise an error.
The argument must be a loaded SoundResource; otherwise the engine raises 'resource (SoundResource) is not loaded'.

VideoComponent.summary: Returns the current time as seconds.
